stem: Which sentence from the selection best supports the idea that there have been many changes made to potato chips?

options.label: F
options.text: It was not long before people wanted potato chips without having to go to a restaurant to get them.

options.label: G
options.text: Over the years many more people began making and selling potato chips.

options.label: H
options.text: Bigger and better kinds of packages were designed, and different flavors of chips started appearing.

options.label: J
options.text: What an unusual history the potato chip has, from its accidental beginning in New York State to being perhaps the most popular snack food in the world.
